Falsely advertised

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: Rip off do not download. The ad is nowhere near what it is. You got to love these people that take advantage of your health issues

reviews.title: Fraudulent advertising - does NOT read Blood Sugar‼️‼️‼️
reviews.text: Apple should be ashamed for carrying these dishonest apps that claim to read blood sugar levels‼️  So far, none of the apps that advertise their ability to read blood sugar and blood pressure, actually do so‼️ This is fraud‼️  Especially when they charge high fees for doing nothing but provide only listings‼️  You are scamming people who are in need of help‼️  Shame on you all‼️‼️‼️

reviews.title: False ads
reviews.text: I too have them charging me after I asked to cancel. There is no face scan for blood sugar.  It’s no good for us.

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: I have obtained several of these apps from this developer and in the Facebook ad it shows a picture of a person doing a face scan and it immediately provides a blood glucose level. None of his apps including this one will do that. The person calls it blood glucose journaling in the App Store ad which must mean the advertisement is fake. I have an app with my smart watch that will do blood pressure and stress reading and for not $10/week.
